The '''Zona Miki system''' was located in the [[Thrasybule sector/Legends|Thrasybule sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It shared its name with the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Zona Miki route]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zona Miki [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
